title: Can the Parts Fool the Test? Counterfactual Pairing Cycles for Relational OOD
abstract: arXiv:2610.23248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Relational out-of-distribution errors are easy to describe and hard to evaluate cleanly. An image may be natural, a caption may be fluent, and all mentioned objects may be common, yet the caption may describe the wrong relation in the image. Many evaluations intended to test this behavior can be solved without checking the pairing at all, because negatives differ in caption style, template, length, object frequency, or image statistics. We propose counterfactual pairing cycles, a blocked evaluation primitive that reuses the same two images and the same two captions on both sides of the comparison, changing only which image is paired with which caption. This makes image-only, text-only, and additive component shortcuts cancel exactly in finite samples. translated_title: 局部能否骗过测试？面向关系型分布外误差的反事实配对循环
translated_abstract: 关系型分布外误差很容易描述，却很难进行干净的评估。一幅图像可能是自然的，一个描述（caption）可能是流畅的，且其中提及的所有物体都可能是常见的，但该描述却可能错误地描述了图像中的关系。许多旨在测试这种行为的评估，即使完全不检查图像与描述的配对关系也能被“解决”，因为负样本在描述风格、模板、长度、物体频率或图像统计特性上存在差异。我们提出反事实配对循环，这是一种分块式的评估基元，它在比较的两侧复用相同的两张图像和相同的两个描述，仅改变哪张图像与哪个描述相配对。这使得仅图像、仅文本以及可加性成分等捷径在有限样本中精确地相互抵消。同样的对比还为关系型离群暴露提供了一种训练损失，并为双线性视觉-语言评分提供了一种诊断工具。在合成控制数据、GQA 和 COCO 上，循环分离……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出“反事实配对循环”评估基元：在比较两侧复用相同的两张图像与两个描述、仅改变配对方式，使仅图像、仅文本及可加性捷径在有限样本中精确抵消，从而干净地评估关系型分布外误差，并兼作关系型离群暴露的训练损失与双线性视觉-语言评分的诊断工具。
en_tdlr: Counterfactual pairing cycles reuse the same two images and two captions on both sides of a comparison, changing only which image is paired with which caption, so that image-only, text-only, and additive shortcuts cancel exactly in finite samples—enabling clean evaluation of relational OOD errors, a training loss for relational outlier exposure, and a diagnostic for bilinear vision-language scores.
